messages:
Nadia P: Heads up  partner bulk-import landed overnight. ~8,200 accounts created with owner=NULL and healthscore default 0.0. Playbooks fired and AM inboxes exploded. Need a coordinated backfill + throttling plan.

Vikram S: yikes. Do we know why owner is null? schema mismatch?

Nadia P: partner CSV omitted owner_id for guest imports; ingestion job set owner=NULL and ran downstream triggers (on_create) which kicked off onboarding playbooks.

Marco Y: we should immediately mute on_create triggers for the ingestion pipeline and pause outbound playbooks for accounts with source = 'partner_bulk_v2'. Can we flag them with temp tag `bulk_import_inflight`?

Vikram S: yes. Quick mitigation SQL to mark and pause: 
```sql
UPDATE accounts
SET tags = array_append(tags, 'bulk_import_inflight')
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '6 hours' AND source = 'partner_bulk_v2';
-- then set automation flag
UPDATE accounts SET playbooks_enabled = false WHERE tags @> ARRAY['bulk_import_inflight'];
```

Nadia P: OK please run mitigation in prod now. Also need a backfill plan to populate owner, recompute healthscore, and re-enqueue playbooks in a controlled manner.

Vikram S: planning a 3-step backfill: 1) owner resolution (map partner_owner_email -> cs_owner_id) 2) owner write in 500-row batches with circuit breaker 3) healthscore recompute + playbook enqueue in region-aware throttles.

Zoe M: AMs will need context templates explaining why they might see a backlog of tasks. I can prepare email + internal note. Also request a CSV export of accounts per AM so they can triage manually if needed.

Marco Y: throttling design: per-region token bucket limiting playbook enqueues to 200/minute, with backpressure to avoid AM inbox floods. Pseudocode: 
```
for account_batch in batches:
  if tokens[region] > 0:
    enqueue_playbooks(account_batch)
    tokens[region] -= len(account_batch)
  else:
    sleep(1)
```

Vikram S: owner resolution SQL draft: 
```sql
SELECT a.id, p.owner_email
FROM accounts a
JOIN partner_imports p ON p.account_ref = a.partner_ref
WHERE a.tags @> ARRAY['bulk_import_inflight'];
```
Then map to cs_owner_id via users table and update.

Nadia P: owners: Nadia (CS Ops lead), Vikram (Data Eng), Marco (Platform throttle), Zoe (Enablement comms). Timeline: mitigation now, staging dry-run of backfill tomorrow 03:00 UTC, gradual prod resume earliest 48h after staging metrics good.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-9002 created: "bulk-import-backfill-and-throttle" assigned to Vikram S.

Vikram S: monitoring: track created_at window counts, number of playbooks enqueued per minute per region, AM inbox growth delta, and healthscore delta distribution post-backfill. Gate conditions: pause resume if AM inbox growth > 30% vs baseline OR if median healthscore change for top-10 ARR accounts < -0.15.

Zoe M: I'll draft AM template: why tasks may be queued, how to filter by tag `bulk_import_inflight`, and offer a 'hold' macro. Will also add a one-click CSV export link for owners in the console.

Marco Y: I'll push a config toggle `playbook.resume.bulk_import=true/false` and a staging job id. Also will add idempotency keys to avoid duplicate enqueues: `enqueue+account_id+import_batch_id`.

Nadia P: thanks. After staging dry-run well reconvene to validate owner mapping accuracy and AM feedback. Volunteers for manual spot-checks on the first 200 accounts please DM me.

Vikram S: schedule: mitigation applied, staging backfill scheduled 2025-12-02 03:00 UTC (dry_run). Will post run id when available.

ops-bot: Staging job scheduled -> https://jobs.redwood/reports/1501 (dry_run=true).
